title: Redox regulation of RAD51 Cys319 and homologous recombination by peroxiredoxin 1.
authors: Skoko, John J; Cao, Juxiang; Gaboriau, David; Attar, Myriam; Asan, Alparslan; Hong, Lisa; Paulsen, Candice E; Ma, Hongqiang; Liu, Yang; Wu, Hanzhi; Harkness, Trey; Furdui, Cristina M; Manevich, Yefim; Morrison, Ciaran G; Brown, Erika T; Normolle, Daniel; Spies, Maria; Spies, Michael Ashley; Carroll, Kate; Neumann, Carola A
one_liner_zh: 该文研究PRDX1对RAD51 Cys319氧化还原调控影响同源重组修复，并用MD模拟dT-DNA与RAD51结合/解离，属蛋白质-DNA互作但非典型TF-DNA体系，方法可迁移。
abstract: RAD51 is a critical recombinase that functions in concert with auxiliary mediator proteins to direct the homologous recombination (HR) DNA repair pathway. We show that Cys319 RAD51 possesses nucleophilic characteristics and is important for irradiation-induced RAD51 foci formation and resistance to inhibitors of poly (ADP-ribose) polymerase (PARP). We have previously identified that cysteine (Cys) oxidation of proteins can be important for activity and modulated via binding to peroxiredoxin 1 (PRDX1). PRDX1 reduces peroxides and coordinates the signaling actions of protein binding partners. Loss of PRDX1 inhibits irradiation-induced RAD51 foci formation and represses HR DNA repair. PRDX1-deficient human breast cancer cells and mouse embryonic fibroblasts display disrupted RAD51 foci formation and decreased HR, resulting in increased DNA damage and sensitization of cells to irradiation. Following irradiation cells deficient in PRDX1 had increased incorporation of the sulfenylation probe DAz-2 in RAD51 Cys319, a functionally-significant, thiol that PRDX1 is critical for maintaining in a reduced state. Molecular dynamics (MD) simulations of dT-DNA bound to a non-oxidized RAD51 protein showed tight binding throughout the simulation, while dT-DNA dissociated from an oxidized Cys319 RAD51 filament. These novel data establish RAD51 Cys319 as a functionally-significant site for the redox regulation of HR and cellular responses to IR.
abstract_zh: RAD51是一种关键的重组酶，与辅助介导蛋白协同作用，指导同源重组（HR）DNA修复通路。我们证明Cys319 RAD51具有亲核特性，并且对辐射诱导的RAD51焦点形成以及对聚（ADP-核糖）聚合酶（PARP）抑制剂的抗性至关重要。我们先前已鉴定出蛋白质的半胱氨酸（Cys）氧化可对其活性起重要作用，并通过与过氧化物氧化还原蛋白1（PRDX1）结合进行调节。PRDX1还原过氧化物并协调蛋白结合伙伴的信号传导作用。PRDX1的缺失抑制辐射诱导的RAD51焦点形成并抑制HR DNA修复。PRDX1缺陷的人乳腺癌细胞和小鼠胚胎成纤维细胞表现出RAD51焦点形成紊乱和HR降低，导致DNA损伤增加和细胞对辐射的敏感性增强。辐射后，PRDX1缺陷细胞中RAD51 Cys319的磺酰化探针DAz-2掺入增加，这是一个功能上重要的硫醇，PRDX1对其维持还原状态至关重要。对dT-DNA与非氧化RAD51蛋白结合的分子动力学（MD）模拟显示，在整个模拟过程中结合紧密，而dT-DNA从氧化Cys319 RAD51丝上解离。这些新数据确立了RAD51 Cys319作为HR和细胞对IR反应氧化还原调节的功能重要位点。
